text: Nepali licence plates are typically fairly long, with the most common design being white. Private vehicles use red plates, while public vehicles use black ones.
text_zh: 尼泊爾車牌通常相當長，最常見的設計是白色。私人車輛使用紅色車牌，公共車輛則使用黑色車牌。

text: All of the road coverage in Nepal was taken with what’s commonly referred to as **“shitcam”**, which is a low-quality camera that can typically be recognised by the brownish colours and often, but not always, by a large circular blur covering the Street View car.
NOTE: Shitcam coverage is also very common in India and can rarely be found in Bangladesh and Sri Lanka.
text_zh: 尼泊爾的所有街景覆蓋都是用俗稱**「屎鏡」（shitcam）**的相機拍攝的，這是一種畫質低劣的相機，通常可藉由偏褐色調辨識，而且經常（但非總是）伴隨著一個覆蓋住 Google 車的大型圓形模糊。
注意：屎鏡覆蓋在印度也非常常見，在孟加拉和斯里蘭卡則較少見。

text: Nepal drives on the** left side** of the road.
text_zh: 尼泊爾是**靠左側**駕駛。

text: Nepal uses the **Devanagari script**, which can be recognised by the line going through the top of each word and the straight vertical lines found in the majority of all letters.

NOTE: The characters ङ and especially ङ्ग are much more common in Nepali than in Hindi/Marathi. It is also quite common to find [native Devanagari numbers](https://maps.app.goo.gl/iZWe7Td5ovENJDEF7) on signage in Nepal, which is very rare in India.
text_zh: 尼泊爾使用**天城體文字**（Devanagari script），其特徵是每個文字上方都有一條貫穿的橫線，且大多數字母都有筆直的垂直線。
注意：字元 ङ、特別是 ङ्ग 在尼泊爾語中比在印地語／馬拉地語中常見得多。在尼泊爾的招牌上也常能看到[本地的天城體數字](https://maps.app.goo.gl/iZWe7Td5ovENJDEF7)，這在印度非常罕見。

text: Nepal typically uses square concrete poles in the flat areas, and thin metallic poles in the mountainous regions. The poletops vary, but it is often some kind of trident.

The concrete pole with a [trident pole top and triangle supports](https://maps.app.goo.gl/ZpwKw2HMY3K4QkQy9) is unique to Nepal. Another common pole almost unique to Nepal is a concrete square pole with [2 vertical insulators](https://maps.app.goo.gl/RBVJCNrtq2enZDS47) on the sides with a wide gap between them. Other poles can often appear very similar to poles in India.
text_zh: 尼泊爾在平原地區通常使用方形水泥電線桿，山區則使用細金屬桿。桿頂造型不一，但通常某種程度上類似三叉戟。
帶有[三叉戟桿頂與三角形支撐結構](https://maps.app.goo.gl/ZpwKw2HMY3K4QkQy9)的水泥電線桿是尼泊爾特有的。另一種幾乎是尼泊爾獨有的常見電線桿是方形水泥桿，其兩側帶有[兩個垂直絕緣子](https://maps.app.goo.gl/RBVJCNrtq2enZDS47)，且中間有很大的間距。其他電線桿看起來常與印度的電線桿非常相似。

text: Nepal commonly uses **outer yellow road lines** that are either [dashed](https://maps.app.goo.gl/QEJcARP1NNPetPwS8) or [solid](https://maps.app.goo.gl/sAwmxo23B4o9Hc4m7), with dashed white lines in the middle of bigger roads. Solid outer yellows are very common in eastern Bagmati province.
text_zh: 尼泊爾普遍使用[虛線](https://maps.app.goo.gl/QEJcARP1NNPetPwS8)或[實線](https://maps.app.goo.gl/sAwmxo23B4o9Hc4m7)的**外側黃色道路標線**，較大道路的中間則為白色虛線。外側黃線在巴格馬蒂省（Bagmati）東部非常普遍。

text: Nepal mainly uses **black-and-white striped concrete bollards** that often have a **red marking** on the top. The amount of stripes vary from 3 to 5.
text_zh: 尼泊爾主要使用**黑白相間的水泥路樁**，頂部通常有**紅色標記**。條紋數量從 3 到 5 條不等。

text: You will see **flat agricultural areas** in the south as well as high altitude **mountain roads** in the northern half of Nepal.
text_zh: 你會在尼泊爾南部看到**平坦的農業區**，以及北部地區的高海拔**山路**。

text: Most buildings are either colorful blocky multi-story structures or small houses with painted concrete, red brick, or thatched looking walls, with either a tiled or tin roof. As part of the building facade, you will often spot [triangle shaped decorations](https://maps.app.goo.gl/YV9ysBvzpGBpQdwJ9).
text_zh: 大多數建築物不是色彩繽紛、呈方塊狀的多層結構，就是塗漆水泥、紅磚或茅草般外牆的小房子，並搭配磁磚或鐵皮屋頂。作為建築立面的一部分，你經常會發現[三角形裝飾](https://maps.app.goo.gl/YV9ysBvzpGBpQdwJ9)。

text: Nepal uses black-and-white striped signposts.
NOTE: Within South and Southeast Asia, India, Bhutan, Bangladesh, Sri Lanka and Malaysia also use black-and-white striped signposts.
text_zh: 尼泊爾使用黑白相間的標誌柱。
注意：在南亞和東南亞地區，印度、不丹、孟加拉、斯里蘭卡和馬來西亞也使用黑白相間的標誌柱。

text: This type of **white-painted Buddhist stupa**, sometimes with painted eyes on the sides, are only found in Nepal.
text_zh: 這種**漆白的佛教佛塔**（有時側邊畫有眼睛）僅見於尼泊爾。

text: Districts can show up on addresses, often in English as well.
text_zh: 地址上通常會顯示行政區，而且經常也會以英文呈現。

text: The area in the far south close to the Indian border is almost completely flat, while the central and northern parts are very high altitude and very mountainous.
text_zh: 極南端靠近印度邊境的地區幾乎完全平坦，而中部和北部地區則是海拔極高且多山。

text: The western hills can be recognised by the **dry landscape**, with a lot of exposed hillsides lacking vegetation.
text_zh: 西部山丘的特徵是**乾燥的景觀**，許多裸露的山坡缺乏植被。

text: **Areca Palms** can be recognised by their very thin trunk and a small crown. They are mainly found in the southeast.
text_zh: **檳榔樹**（Areca Palms）可以透過其非常細的樹幹和小型樹冠來識別。牠們主要分發在東南部。

text: **Canola, **a crop with bright yellow flowers, is mostly found in a few southern pockets in the western half of Nepal.
text_zh: **油菜花**（Canola）是一種開著鮮黃色花朵的農作物，主要分布在尼泊爾西部南部的幾個小區域內。

text: **Chir Pines**, which can be identified from their generally smooth-looking conical or spherical crowns with very long needles, are found everywhere in the mountains, but are much more common in the west, and near Kathmandu.
NOTE: The eastern region is generally greener than the west.
text_zh: **西藏松**（Chir Pines）可從其外觀普遍光滑、呈圓錐形或球形且帶有非常長針葉的樹冠辨識出來，牠們在山區隨處可見，但在西部和加德滿都附近更為常見。
注意：東部地區通常比西部地區更綠。

text: Grass with white and fluffy-looking tips is most commonly found just southeast of Kathmandu.
While it can be found in most of the country, it usually won’t look as white and fluffy outside the dark red coloured region.
text_zh: 帶有白色且蓬鬆外觀尖端的草最常出現在加德滿都的東南方。
雖然它可能出現在該國的大部分地區，但在深紅色區域之外通常不會看起來那麼白且蓬鬆。

text: Japanese cedar trees, which are only found in far eastern Nepal, can typically be recognised by their significant height combined with their narrow, fluffy-looking crowns.
text_zh: 日本柳杉（Japanese cedar trees）僅見於尼泊爾極東部，通常可透過其顯著的高度結合狹窄、蓬鬆外觀的樹冠來辨識。

text: Tea Plantations are also only found in far eastern Nepal. Both in the mountains, and in the flat region.
text_zh: 茶園也僅見於尼泊爾極東部，無論是在山區還是在平原地區都有。

text: **Rounded roof tiles** are most common in the flat regions south of Kathmandu, but are also prevalent further west.
NOTE: Don’t mix this up with the [half-rounded tiles](https://maps.app.goo.gl/4WMe1LBb2TXwU1Za6), which are part of the hint below this.
text_zh: **圓形屋頂瓦片**在加德滿都以南的平原地區最為常見，但也盛行於更西邊的地區。
注意：不要把它跟[半圓形瓦片](https://maps.app.goo.gl/4WMe1LBb2TXwU1Za6)搞混了，後者是下方提示的一部分。

text: West Bengal style roof tiles, which are more organised and have small **diamond shaped protrusions**, are most common in the far west flat region. This hint also works for the [half-rounded tiles](https://maps.app.goo.gl/4WMe1LBb2TXwU1Za6).
text_zh: 西孟加拉風格的屋頂瓦片更有條理且帶有小型**菱形突起**，在極西部的平原地區最為常見。這個提示對於[半圓形瓦片](https://maps.app.goo.gl/4WMe1LBb2TXwU1Za6)也適用。

text: Flat **square shaped stone tiles** that are grey in colour are common south of Kathmandu, more specifically around Birgunj and Janakpur.
NOTE: Neat, square, stone tiles are not found in parts of India that tend to look similar to Nepal.
text_zh: 加德滿都以南常見扁平且呈灰色的**方形石磚**，特別是在比爾甘傑（Birgunj）和賈納克布爾（Janakpur）周遭。
注意：整齊、方形的石磚在印度部分地區並不多見，雖然那裡看起來跟尼泊爾有些類似。

text: Rectangular tiles that are** less organised** in shape and placement are common in western mountain towns, but can also be found towards the center of the country.
text_zh: 形狀與鋪設**較不規整**的長方形石磚常見於西部山區城鎮，但在該國中部也能找到。

text: Roofs made from sheets of** corrugated metal** are most common between Birgunj and Janakpur.
text_zh: 由**波浪鐵皮**製成的屋頂在比爾甘傑和賈納克布爾之間最為常見。

text: Roofs that have a **railing** along the sides of the roofs, usually made of dark concrete, are found in some parts of western Nepal. They are most common in the Tulsipur valley, where the railings sometimes have a [stair shape](https://maps.app.goo.gl/ikhV9mfvD98582v9A). The easternmost region where they’re found is the plains by Kawasoti. The westernmost regions often have lower quality “railings”, sometimes consisting of a few sticks.
text_zh: 屋頂兩側有**欄杆**（通常由深色混凝土製成）的屋頂，可以在尼泊爾西部的某些地區找到。它們在圖爾西普爾（Tulsipur）山谷最為常見，那裡的欄杆有時帶有[階梯形狀](https://maps.app.goo.gl/ikhV9mfvD98582v9A)。能找到它們的最東邊地區是卡瓦索蒂（Kawasoti）的平原。最西部的地區通常用品質較差的「欄杆」，有時僅由幾根木棍組成。

text: Gable ends decorated by **carvings of gods**, goddesses, and other religious symbols, usually painted in a golden colour, are mostly around Kawasoti, west of Bharatpur.
text_zh: 山形牆上裝飾著**神明雕刻**、女神及其他宗教符號（通常漆成金色），主要分布在巴拉特普爾（Bharatpur）以西的卡瓦索蒂周遭。

text: Fences of varying build quality, made of mainly sticks, are most commonly found in the eastern plains of Nepal.
text_zh: 主要由木棍製成、建造品質參差不齊的圍籬，最常見於尼泊爾東部平原。

text: In the far east, you will mainly see roofs made of sheet metal with a triangular "window" just below the ridge of the roof, and an outwards sloping section below it.
text_zh: 在極東地區，你會主要看到金屬鐵皮屋頂，其屋脊下方有一個三角形「窗戶」，下方則是一個向外傾斜的區段。

text: Large hip roofs made of sheet metal with a small protrusion just below the ridge are found around Biratnagar in the east.
text_zh: 東部比拉特納格爾（Biratnagar）周遭可以找到大型金屬鐵皮歇山頂，屋脊下方有一個小突起。

text: Similar to the above hint, hip roofs made of sheet metal with an even smaller protruding piece of metal at the ridge are mainly found west of and around Biratnagar.
text_zh: 與上述線索類似，屋脊處有一個更小突起金屬件的金屬鐵皮歇山頂，主要分布在比拉特納格爾以西及周遭。

text: Mosques are concentrated in a few Muslim majority spots in southern Nepal.
- In the east, just around Janakpur.
- In the east, just around Birgunj.
- In the west, just around Nepalgunj.
- In the east, around Biratnagar and west of the Koshi river.
text_zh: 清真寺集中在尼泊爾南部的幾個穆斯林多數聚落：
- 在東部，就在賈納克布爾周遭。
- 在東部，就在比爾甘傑周遭。
- 在西部，就在尼泊爾根傑（Nepalgunj）周遭。
- 在東部，在比拉特納格爾周遭以及戈西河（Koshi river）以西。

text: Small** round clay huts** with **thatched roofs** are mainly found around Birgunj.
NOTE: These are also common just over the border in India.
text_zh: 帶有**茅草屋頂**的小型**圓形黏土小屋**主要分布在比爾甘傑周遭。
注意：這些在印度國界另一側也很常見。

text: Poles with a **cross** attached near the top are common in the east.
text_zh: 頂部附近附有**十字架**的電線桿在東部很常見。

text: In Kathmandu, you’ll find poles with an asymmetrical crossbar, which has a triangular attachment on top of it, as well as a support bar below it.
text_zh: 在加德滿都，你會看到電線桿帶有非對稱的橫桿，其上方有一個三角形附件，下方則有一根支撐桿。

text: While the most common water tank colours in Nepal are green and black, which are found everywhere, **yellow** ones are mainly found in the east.
text_zh: 雖然尼泊爾最常見的水塔顏色是到處都有的綠色和黑色，但**黃色**水塔主要在東部找到。

text: An orange google car can be found around:
- Nepalgunj in the west
- Madi, south of Bharatpur in the central south
- Biratnagar in the east
- Birtamod in the far east.
text_zh: 橘色 Google car 可以出現在以下地點：
- 西部的尼泊爾根傑
- 中南部巴拉特普爾以南的馬迪（Madi）
- 東部的比拉特納格爾
- 極東的比爾塔莫德（Birtamod）。

text: An orange car with a blue ribbon on the front is found around Biratnagar.
text_zh: 車頭帶有藍色緞帶的橘色車可以在比拉特納格爾周遭找到。

text: A blue car is found around:
- Pokhara, under the Nepal label
- Birgunj, southwest of Kathmandu
- Malangawa, near the Indian border southeast of Kathmandu.
text_zh: 藍色車可以在以下地點找到：
- 波卡拉（Pokhara），位於尼泊爾標籤下方
- 比爾甘傑，加德滿都西南方
- 馬朗加瓦（Malangawa），加德滿都東南方靠近印度邊境處。

text: If the blue car has an antenna, you will be around Pokhara.
text_zh: 如果藍色車有天線，你就會在波卡拉一帶。

text: A white car can be found in the following areas:
- Around Butwal, southwest of the Nepal label
- On the H10 going to Pokhara
- On the H04 east to Kathmandu
- On some roads near Kathmandu
- Northeast of Birgunj, southwest of Kathmandu
- From Janakpur to Lahan, southeast of Kathmandu
- Around Itahari, in the east.
text_zh: 白色車可以在以下地區找到：
- 布特沃爾（Butwal）周遭，尼泊爾標籤西南方
- 前往波卡拉的 H10 公路上
- 東往加德滿都的 H04 公路上
- 加德滿都附近的某些道路上
- 比爾甘傑東北方、加德滿都西南方
- 從賈納克布爾到拉漢（Lahan），加德滿都東南方
- 伊塔哈里（Itahari）周遭，位於東部。

text: A car with a black spoiler is found just around Janakpur, southeast of Kathmandu.
text_zh: 帶有黑色擾流板的車輛可以在加德滿都東南方、賈納克布爾一帶找到。

text: A regular grey car can be found around Kathmandu, and to the southeast, around Lahan.
text_zh: 一般灰色車可以在加德滿都以及東南方的拉漢一帶找到。

text: A blocky grey truck can be found east of Birgunj and just south of Kathmandu.
text_zh: 方正的灰色卡車可以在比爾甘傑以東和加德滿都正南方找到。

text: A grey car with a visible backlight can be found in the following areas:
- Around Pokhara, under the Nepal label
- Around Kathmandu
- North of Malangawa, near the Indian border southeast of Kathmandu
- East of Itahari, in the east.
text_zh: 帶有明顯後車燈的灰色車可以在以下地區找到：
- 波卡拉周遭，位於尼泊爾標籤下方
- 加德滿都周遭
- 馬朗加瓦以北，加德滿都東南方的印度邊境附近
- 伊塔哈里以東，位於東部。

text: A red car, that usually has a long antenna, can be found in Kathmandu, and north of Janakpur, which is southeast of Kathmandu.
text_zh: 紅色車通常帶有長天線，可以在加德滿都以及加德滿都東南方的賈納克布爾以北找到。

text: Some roads north of Siddhicharan, in eastern Nepal are unique due to the high elevation hills with dark green rhododendron bushes growing in abundance. The bushes have [red flowers](https://maps.app.goo.gl/ZyeniQ6umodMPa7h9) which can be hard to see.
text_zh: 尼泊爾東部希迪恰蘭（Siddhicharan）以北的一些道路非常獨特，因為這裡有高海拔丘陵，生長著大量深綠色的杜鵑花叢。這些灌木叢帶有[紅色花朵](https://maps.app.goo.gl/ZyeniQ6umodMPa7h9)，可能比較難注意到。

text: This foggy and gloomy road hosts the only natural forest dominated by east himalayan fir. You can recognise it from all the tall dark trees present around the road. It is located just northwest of Bhimeshwor Municipality, east of Kathmandu.
text_zh: 這條充滿霧氣且陰暗的道路擁有唯一以東喜馬拉雅冷杉為主的天然林。你可以從道路周遭所有高大深色的樹木認出它。它位於比梅什沃爾市（Bhimeshwor Municipality）西北方、加德滿都以東。

text: This sketchy yellow/orange dirt road can be recognised from the high elevation landscape with the high elevation oaks. It can be found northeast of Phungling in far northeastern Nepal.
text_zh: 這條路況不佳的黃色/橘色泥土路可以從高海拔景觀以及高海拔橡樹來辨識。它位於尼泊爾極東北邊普芬林（Phungling）的東北方。

text: This dirt track in a northwestbound valley can be recognised by the **snowcapped mountains** to the northwest. You can find it north of the Khaptad national park in western Nepal.
text_zh: 這條位於西北走向山谷中的泥土小徑可以透過西北方的**雪山**來辨識。你可以 於尼泊爾西部的卡普塔德國家公園（Khaptad national park）北方找到它。

text: Trekker coverage in Nepal is limited to the **northeast** of the country, in the general area southwest of Mount Everest.
text_zh: 尼泊爾的徒步拍攝範圍僅限於該國的**東北部**，大約在聖母峰西南方的區域。

text: **Green forests** and trees are found in the southern parts of the Nepalese trekker coverage.
text_zh: **綠色森林**與樹木出現在尼泊爾徒步拍攝範圍的南部。

text: **Barren mountain trails** are found in the northern parts of the coverage.
text_zh: **荒涼的山徑**出現在拍攝範圍的北部。

text: A lot of the coverage in the vicinity of Namche Bazar can be summarised as being sunny, with the trails going **close to the treeline**, meaning you will be either near the top of or just above a forest for most of this coverage. You will generally see barren or snowy mountains in some direction.
text_zh: 南崎巴扎（Namche Bazar）附近的許多街景可以總結為天氣晴朗，小徑**接近林木線**，這意味著在大部分的拍攝範圍中，你不是在森林邊緣就是剛好在森林上方。你通常會在某些方向看到荒涼的山脈或雪山。

text: Namche Bazar is by far the **largest** and **most densely populated** settlement with trekker coverage. There is also some coverage [looking down on the town](https://www.google.com/maps/@27.8056067,86.71193,2a,90y,112.78h,82.14t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1s9HNBGJ7FGOq9a4fOPyvWcg!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu).
text_zh: 南崎巴扎是目前擁有徒步拍攝範圍中**最大**且**人口最稠密**的聚落。這裡也有一些[俯瞰該城鎮](https://www.google.com/maps/@27.8056067,86.71193,2a,90y,112.78h,82.14t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1s9HNBGJ7FGOq9a4fOPyvWcg!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu)的街景。

text: The southernmost trekker coverage is situated in the town of Lukla, which can be recognised by the narrow street with relatively large buildings, combined with the **extremely dark coverage**.
text_zh: 最南端的徒步拍攝範圍位於路卡拉（Lukla）鎮，這裡的特徵是狹窄的街道搭配相對大型的建築，再加上**極度昏暗的街景**。

text: Khumjung village, situated just north of Namche Bazar, can be recognised by the **jagged mountain** towering above the village. Almost every house in the village has a **green roof**.
Beware that there is a label for Khumjung further north, which is not close to the village.
text_zh: 坤珍村（Khumjung village）位於南崎巴扎的正北方，可以透過高聳於村莊上方的高聳**鋸齒狀山峰**來辨識。村裡幾乎每棟房子都有**綠色屋頂**。
請注意，更北邊有一個坤珍的地標，但它並不在村莊附近。

text: Pangboche is a fairly large settlement with fairly bright coverage. The surrounding landscape mainly consists of **forested mountains** nearby and some taller mountains in the distance.
text_zh: 龐波契（Pangboche）是一個相當大的聚落，街景相當明亮。周遭景觀主要由附近的**森林山脈**和遠處的一些更高山峰組成。

text: Phorste is a fairly scarcely built settlement with a massive **recognizable mountain** close by. There are a lot of dead-looking trees surrounding the village.
text_zh: 弗斯特（Phorste）是一個建築相當稀疏的聚落，附近有一座巨大的**可辨識山峰**。村莊周圍有許多看起來枯死的樹木。

text: Around the southern tip of the Nepalese trekker coverage, you will get this **dark**, overcast coverage inside a forested valley.
text_zh: 在尼泊爾徒步拍攝範圍的最南端附近，你會在森林山谷中看到這種**昏暗**、陰天的街景。

text: North of Phakding you will get more overcast coverage in the same forest valley, however here the coverage is **far brighter**.
text_zh: 在帕克丁（Phakding）北方，你會在同一個森林山谷中遇到更多陰天街景，不過這裡的街景**亮得多**。

text: The coverage from Monjo up to Namche Bazar is also within the same valley, however here the coverage is mostly **sunny** and bright.
text_zh: 從孟卓（Monjo）到南崎巴扎的街景也位於同一個山谷內，不過這裡的街景大多是**晴朗**且明亮的。

text: The valley by Thamu can be recognised by the generally forested mountainsides, combined with the **angle of the valley**, going northwest to southeast.
text_zh: 塔姆（Thamu）旁的山谷可以透過大體上長滿森林的山坡，結合**山谷的角度**（由西北向東南走向）來辨識。

text: Next to the village of Thame you can see this snowy, and **shining bright** mountain range.
text_zh: 在塔美村（Thame）旁，你可以看到這座積雪且**閃耀著明亮光芒**的山脈。

text: Northeast of Namche Bazar, you can find this **semi-green river valley** with clouds covering all mountains surrounding it.
text_zh: 在南崎巴扎的東北方，你可以找到這個**半綠色的河谷**，周圍所有山脈都被雲霧籠罩。

text: On a section north of Phorste, you get a view of the mountain Tobuche, covered in a **blanket of clouds**.
text_zh: 在弗斯特北方的路段，你可以看到被**厚重雲層**覆蓋的托布切峰（Tobuche）。

text: Further north, the cloud blanket is replaced by **small, spotty clouds** somewhat resembling smoke coming out of chimneys.
text_zh: 再往北走，厚重的雲層被**零星的小雲朵**取代，有點像煙囪冒出的煙。

text: Even further north, the clouds disappear completely, and you get a **clear view** of the Tobuche peak.
text_zh: 再往北走，雲層完全消失，你可以**清晰看到**托布切峰。

text: Leaving Tobuche behind, you will find this small, **ice-covered lake**, right by Gokyo, with jagged mountains as a backdrop.
text_zh: 把托布切峰拋在身後，你會在戈基約（Gokyo）旁發現這個被**冰覆蓋的小湖**，背景是鋸齒狀的山脈。

text: North of the icy lake, you reach a barren landscape, with a trail going to the **north-north-west**.
text_zh: 在冰湖以北，你會抵達一片荒涼的景觀，有一條通往**西北偏北**的小徑。

text: East of Gokyo, you reach this **dried out glacial valley**, with bright grey rocks as far as you can see.
NOTE: This valley can less commonly be seen from the trail [north of Gokyo](https://goo.gl/maps/pnV63nxPuKLv6bhd7).
text_zh: 在戈基約東方，你會抵達這個**乾涸的冰河谷**，放眼望去盡是明亮的灰色岩石。
注意：這個山谷從[戈基約北方](https://goo.gl/maps/pnV63nxPuKLv6bhd7)的小徑看過去的機率較低。

text: East of the glacial valley, you get to a somewhat **red-coloured**, rugged mountainside **right next to the trail**.
text_zh: 離開冰河谷地東側，你會來到一處**帶有紅色**、地形崎嶇的山腰，**就在步道旁邊**。

text: Leaving the red mountainside behind, you enter a somewhat **U-shaped valley**, going firmly upwards.
text_zh: 把紅色山腰拋在身後，你會進入一個**U型谷**，一路穩步向上。

text: Above the U-shaped valley, you get a view of this **spiky mountain range**. While there are some clouds around the peaks, they are mostly clearly visible.
text_zh: 在U型谷上方，你可以看見這片**尖峭的山脈**。雖然山峰周圍有些雲霧，但大多能清楚看見。

text: As you lose sight of the spiky mountains, you cross over a **glacier**, which is the largest patch of snow covered ground with coverage in the country.
text_zh: 當你看不見尖峭山脈時，你會跨越一座**冰河**，這是該國有街景覆蓋範圍中面積最大的覆雪地面。

text: The area east of the glacier can be recognised by the many **irregular clouds** spread across the sky and covering various mountain peaks.
text_zh: 冰河東側的區域可以透過天空中散布的許多**不規則雲朵**來辨識，這些雲朵覆蓋了多座山峰。

text: Further along the trail, you get this stunning **view over Tobuche** from the eastern side. The mountains get increasingly covered in clouds to the west.
text_zh: 沿著步道再往前走，你會從東側看到這處令人驚嘆的**都木切峰（Tobuche）景色**。往西望去，山脈被雲層覆蓋的範圍越來越大。

text: Closing in on the final trek toward Everest, you get a view of this wide, **high-altitude river valley**.
text_zh: 接近登頂聖母峰的最後健行路段時，你會看到這片寬闊的**高海拔河谷**。

text: Slightly east of Namche Bazar, you can find this very overcast trail following the mountainside. There are still some trees around, and the trail is noticeably **higher** above the valley than other overcast sections with trees.
text_zh: 在南崎巴札（Namche Bazar）稍東的位置，你可以找到這條沿著山腰、天氣非常陰暗的小徑。周圍仍有一些樹木，而且與其他有樹木的陰暗路段相比，這條小徑明顯**高於**河谷。

text: East of the POI called ‘Deboche’, you get this very **overcast forest coverage**. The dirt here is very bright and sandy, which can help differentiate it from the southern trail.
text_zh: 在名為「Deboche」的地標以東，你會看到這種非常**陰暗的森林覆蓋**。這裡的泥土非常明亮且帶有沙質，這有助於它與南部的小徑區分開來。

text: You can recognise the trail between Pangboche and Dingboche by the massive mountains, combined with the sun looking somewhat **hazy**.
text_zh: 你可以透過巨大的山脈，加上看起來有些**朦朧**的太陽，來辨認 Pangboche 和 Dingboche 之間的小徑。

text: North of Dingboche, you reach a high-altitude valley with very **low clouds** covering the sky and most of the surrounding mountains.
text_zh: 在丁波切（Dingboche）以北，你會來到一個高海拔河谷，天空和大多數周圍山脈都被**低矮的雲層**覆蓋。

text: Closing in on Everest, you get this completely barren landscape, with the trail going to the **north-north-east**.
text_zh: 接近聖母峰時，你會看到這片完全荒蕪的景觀，小徑朝著**北北東北**方向延伸。

text: Reaching the endpoint of the coverage, you finally get a stunning view of the world's tallest mountain, **Mount Everest**.
text_zh: 走到街景覆蓋的盡頭，你終於能一睹世界最高山峰**聖母峰**（Mount Everest）的壯麗景色。
